Reference / http/proxy

http/proxy#

A client that goes through an HTTP proxy: http requests are forwarded, https ones tunnelled with CONNECT and verified end to end.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let proxy = ProxyPolicy(ParsedUrl("http://proxy.internal:3128").parts());
let client = Proxied(proxy: proxy, resolver: SystemResolution(), tls: tls, policy: ClientPolicy(), clock: SystemClock());

Description#

A client that goes through an HTTP proxy: http requests are forwarded, https ones tunnelled with CONNECT and verified end to end.

Public API#

object Proxied#

object Proxied does Exchanging, Closing

A client that sends everything through one proxy.

Proxied(proxy is ProxyPolicy, resolver is Resolving, tls is TlsClientPolicy, policy is ClientPolicy, clock is Timing)
